questions_and_proposals.question: Как сохранять обычный текст без поломки frozen v1 intents?
questions_and_proposals.why: Определяет проверяемое поведение первого варианта и границы совместимости.

proposal.auto: Only .txt/.md casefold extension selects utf8_text; other files binary. Extension is a selection hint, not proof of text validity.
proposal.frozen_mode: Resolve auto before writing INTENT; freeze binary|utf8_text with profile and producer version. Never infer mode again on reopen.
proposal.UTF8: Strict incremental decoder on captured bytes including final flush; preserve BOM/CRLF/multibyte/raw bytes. Invalid capture has no sealed input/acceptance; explicit new binary intent available, no silent fallback under same IDs.
proposal.media: Validated utf8_text → text/plain; binary → application/octet-stream. No OCR/PDF/MIME library.
proposal.compatibility: Version-specific fields normalization, document and draft producer, limits validation selected by frozen intent profile. Preserve old r1-authoring/1 exact fields/docs/draft/provenance/hashes/replay even with original removed.
proposal.search: Existing content indexing supports text/plain ≤4MiB. Up to64MiB text originals may be saved, but >4MiB shows size_limit and title/filename search only; never prefix truncation. Separate visible cache rebuild operation after accept/external change/search request; query remains logically readonly.

questions_and_proposals.question: Как обновлять открытый Bank после записи отдельной командой?
questions_and_proposals.why: Определяет проверяемое поведение первого варианта и границы совместимости.

proposal.signal: Read-only max commit_sequence + last commit_id and configured Bank identity/root generation. Do not compare PRAGMA data_version from different short-lived connections.
proposal.connection: Existing Store._connect(False,_allow_recovery=False), bounded SQL progress/time, explicit close. Passive observer never performs hot-journal recovery.
proposal.worker: Existing single worker/queue; no overlapping polls, coalesce changes while busy, cancel/close safely, discard stale generation/root results.
proposal.UI: Refresh Bank first page/snapshot cursor after accepted external change. Keep pinned selected revision/history/search snapshot and user tab; show newer-head notice instead of silently replacing pin.
proposal.errors: Keep previous rows and visible stale/disconnected/busy state, not false empty success. Sequence decrease or DB replacement triggers resync. Token is a hint, actual detail/query retains integrity verification.
proposal.not_scheduler: No network/research/import/Watch or generalized jobs; rebuilding derived local cache is a separate visible operation.

questions_and_proposals.question: Как сохранять диагностику без смешения с accepted receipt?
questions_and_proposals.why: Определяет проверяемое поведение первого варианта и границы совместимости.

proposal.storage: Reuse existing append-only attempt_receipts table in physical storage/1; no DDL/index/canonical schema change.
proposal.format: App-private closed versioned local-bank-attempt/1 wrapper: UUIDv4 attempt_id, valid nullable tx/hash, time, explicit outcome/code, optional independently validated canonical receipt. Schema + semantic correlation checks and exact row/blob identity required.
proposal.canonical_boundary: LOCAL_WRITE_ENVELOPE accepts only ACCEPTED/REPLAY/CONFLICT/REJECTED/INCOMPLETE/INTEGRITY_ERROR. UNKNOWN/IO_ERROR/RETRYABLE_BUSY/CANCELLED/READY_NOT_PUBLISHED belong to private diagnostic envelope, never fabricated canonical receipt.
proposal.transaction: Separate short append only after canonical transaction and rollback connections close. Store._receipt stays pure. Diagnostics write failure does not downgrade known ACCEPTED/REPLAY; show ATTEMPT_NOT_RECORDED while preserving exact outcome/IDs.
proposal.reads: Add private attempt.get/result schema; original receipt.get stays canonical and missing accepted receipt is RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND, never proof of failed commit. Extend app read-result latest_diagnostic_attempt closed placeholder to explicit available/not_recorded/unavailable/incomplete_scan; preserve legacy placeholder and known legacy canonical rows.
proposal.lookup: Existing rowid descending cursor, finite paged scan/progress handler. No transaction index exists; if scan incomplete return incomplete_scan + cursor, not not_recorded. Query latest by insertion order, not unreliable wall clock.
proposal.reopen: Recorded known failures survive reopen. Process death before terminal append or unavailable/unconfigured Bank leaves explicit unknown/unavailable: inspect actual canonical receipt/intake and exact retry. No negative conclusion from absence. Invalid tx not correlated to another transaction.
proposal.privacy: Bounded codes/IDs only; no secret/raw file contents/exception text in diagnostics.

questions_and_proposals.question: Как обеспечить запуск и минимум сохранности без разрастания первого варианта?
questions_and_proposals.why: Определяет проверяемое поведение первого варианта и границы совместимости.

proposal.roots: Explicit seven sibling private roots: bank,intake,stage,cache,output,source,authoring; validated local NTFS and disjoint. Existing backend role sets preserved.
proposal.setup: Explicit setup action with reviewed paths; reuse private_directory and Store.initialize. Versioned private config outside Git, publish only after all guards/schema/runtime checks pass. Never lazy-create on read, reset unknown/partial DB or overwrite existing config silently.
proposal.launcher: Single documented command/launcher using validated project Python environment, config path and import preflight; no services, registry, provider/network or OS rights changes.
proposal.recovery: Partial setup remains non-ready with preserved paths; explicit safe retry checks existing known roots/header or requests intervention for unknown DB. Authoring preparation/publication/acceptance states remain distinct and inspectable after reopen.
proposal.safeguarding: Manual verified SQLite backup/export via existing guarded source/owned output and SQLite backup snapshot before meaningful real-data adoption. Verify copy reopen, header/catalog/foreign keys and bounded retained integrity; disclose any unverified content/limits. No blind live DB file copy. Restore/full scheduling/retention/migrations remain R3.
proposal.adoption: Owned synthetic native setup/integration first; actual real-root setup and user visual save→find→original→reopen gate separate before claiming usable real Bank.
